summary: Connect the Kinesis library item (n1) to the Excalidraw editor with an arrow.
rationale: The note asks to connect the Kinesis item to the editor. One unlabelled arrow n1 --> editor is added; no ids, labels, styles, positions or library items change. The ADR does not say what Kinesis feeds into the editor, so the edge carries no label; add one in the editor if the relationship should be named. Kinesis is not a component in ADR-010 as written, so if this edge reflects a real design element the ADR text would need an amendment to describe it.
